result.summary: No critical breakage is visible, but two layout issues make the feed look unfinished or obstructed.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second “Popular right now” restaurant card, obscuring part of its image and any content immediately below it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable feed equal to the navigation bar height plus the safe-area inset so cards can scroll fully above the bar.

issues.description: Horizontal content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge: the category row ends with an unexplained partial pill, and the third “Fastest near you” card and title are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel side padding and a deliberate partial-card preview, or snap items so enough of the next item and its label remain visible.
